{{Quote|a simple grip, a curved approach, one inlaid with the bone of the Cartusion whale, pastillion ore or black onk.|The options given for lightsaber design by Huyang|<ref name="ATOS" />}}
'''Black onk''' was a substance which could be used as an inlay in the handle of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. When a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] visited the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Architect droid/Legends|architect droid]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] stationed there informed them that a black onk infused handle was an option they could select when constructing their own lightsabers.<ref name="ATOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Black onk was first mentioned in [[2012]] in ''[[A Test of Strength]]'', the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth]] season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', the script for which was written [[Christian Taylor]]. The substance was also mentioned in the trivia gallery for the episode on [[StarWars.com]].
